curatedMovie.curiosityHook: Left completely alone to wander the cavernous freighter for months, Laura begins to face the quiet unease of the empty ship.
curatedMovie.description: En route to Station 42 aboard the decaying freighter Kassandra, young medic Laura stands a solitary four-month watch while the rest of the crew remains frozen in deep hibernation.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: A slow, thoughtful, and suspenseful sci-fi thriller wrapped in heavy solitude and cold industrial grit.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Directed by Ivan Engler and Ralph Etter, this Swiss sci-fi mystery delivers deliberate, slow-burn tension grounded in claustrophobic isolation and industrial space travel.
